title: The check
notices: One of three answers right on the understanding check.

recorded.text: That check was mostly guesses, and that's normal on day one.
Here's the trick: read your notes back once before you start building.

new.text: Most of that check was guesses.
Were the answers in your notes, or only in your head?
Read your notes back once before you build.

lines.text: Because the check is the first thing Jay grades.
Reading your notes back takes thirty seconds,
and every right answer is a hundred points.
